list: Leonida Platinum — the official 55 trophies, with sourced guides

trophies.guide: The platinum is the finish line, not a task of its own: it pops once the other 54 are done. Budget a very long playthrough — the full run is estimated at around 200 hours — and keep cheats off entirely, since they switch trophies off. The 100% completion trophy is the hardest single step on the road, so plan the endgame around it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.short: Earn every other trophy to take the platinum.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies first — the platinum unlocks once they are all done.
Plan for a long haul: the full run is estimated at around 200 hours.
Save the 100% completion trophy for the endgame — it is rated the hardest on the list.
Do not use cheats at any point — they switch trophies off.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list: push the completion counter all the way to 100% by clearing story, side strands, activities and collectibles. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so anything missable has to be done on the way rather than after the credits. Check the counter often and save the cleanup for the endgame.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Clear story, side strands, activities and collectibles — 100% covers the whole game, not one mode.
There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so finish anything missable on the way, not after the credits.
Treat this as the hardest trophy on the list and track your percentage as you go.

trophies.guide: Land stunts while driving — jumps, drifts and near misses all feed the counter — until it reaches 250. It builds up across normal play, so finish the rest by repeating stunt-friendly driving late in the game.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Land stunts — jumps, drifts and near misses — until the counter reaches 250.
The counter counts 250 stunts and builds across normal play, so the rest can be finished late in the game.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each type of activity the game offers at least once — races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling and the rest. You do not need to win or master any of them; one try of each type is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.text: Try each type of activity once — the description names no win or mastery requirement.
One try of each type is enough; you do not need to win or master any of them.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The range holds 42 challenges, and every one of them needs a gold medal. Work through them weapon by weapon, replaying any challenge that lands below gold until it clears. Short focused sessions beat long tired ones when the margins are tight.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.text: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
Every challenge needs a gold medal — the description requires gold in all of them, not just most.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations. Learn one course at a time and repeat it until the win lands; the trophy needs a victory everywhere, not just a single win.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.short: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location.
One win is not enough — the trophy needs a victory at every location, not a single win.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida's race scene. Mix race types and keep track of which events are already won so you do not repeat a victory that counts only once.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.text: Win 20 different races across Leonida's race scene.
Each race counts once — a repeat win on an event already won does not add to the 20.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take Cal on in a fishing challenge and beat him. Get comfortable with the reeling rhythm in a few casual fishing sessions first, so the challenge itself is not your first time holding a rod.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.short: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.text: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
The challenge is a fishing contest against Cal — win that contest and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

dispute.a: KeenGamer describes it as only potentially missable.
dispute.b: PlanetGTA6 notes that no reliable missable list exists yet.

trophies.guide: The one trophy you can genuinely miss. There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and Lucia's balcony spot in Chapter 1 vanishes once that chapter ends — with no mission replay and no New Game Plus to go back for it. Start meditating in Chapter 1 and keep going until every spot is done.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.short: Meditate at all 18 spots — start in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Start in Chapter 1: Lucia's balcony meditation counts toward the 18.
Visit every meditation spot across Leonida until all 18 are done.
Do the balcony spot before Chapter 1 ends — it is gone after that chapter.
Remember there is no mission replay, so a skipped spot cannot be replayed later.
Treat this as the only potentially missable trophy on the list.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track down the unique animal Bret wants hunted and take it down for him. The hunt opens through Bret's strand — follow it until the target animal is named, then go after it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.text: Hunt the unique animal Bret wants, through Bret's strand — follow it until the target animal is named, then go after it.
No count or extra condition is named — the one hunt is the whole requirement.

trophies.guide: Collectible cards come in sets — finish three full sets to take this one. Pick up cards wherever you find them across Leonida and work toward three complete sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.text: Complete 3 collectible card sets.
Cards come in sets — a set counts only when it is complete, so finish three full sets.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations around Leonida. Fold it into your travel — a quick stop whenever you reach somewhere new — and the counter climbs without a dedicated grind.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.text: WAiNK It at 100 locations around Leonida.
Each location counts once — 100 different locations, not 100 uses in one place.

trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the game's challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more, so a varied playthrough fills the counter; check the list and chase the easiest unfinished ones at the end.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.text: Complete 50 challenges.
The counter is the challenge total — 50 completed challenges, across any challenge type.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.short: Escape a 4-star wanted level with your partner.

steps.text: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Robberies open up in Chapters 3–4, so this one starts mid-story. With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them — plan the route, keep the getaways clean, and do not stop for anything else in between.

trophies.short: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner.

steps.text: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape clean each time. Plan each hit, keep the getaway vehicle close, and treat every vault as its own job — the trophy needs all five escapes.

steps.text: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

trophies.short: Rob an armored truck and escape.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and other scores — hand them to a contact over time and the total adds up across the playthrough.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.text: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
The total is $250,000 through contacts — laundered over time, not earned in one job.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops of Leonida. Weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades all count — normal spending across a full playthrough gets most of the way there, so finish it with a big purchase late in the game.

steps.text: Spend $100,000 across all shops.
Weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades all count — normal spending across a full playthrough gets most of the way there.

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the market. Garages give you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect, so pick them up as the money allows and finish the set in the endgame.

steps.text: Purchase all garage properties.
Buy every garage property on the market — the set is complete only when all are bought.
